extracted.name: Spiced honeyed nuts baked camembert
extracted.description: Top baked camembert with spiced honeyed nuts to add crunchy texture and aromatic sweetness to a classic Christmas starter. Enjoy with crusty bread
ingredient_lines: 250g baking camembert with a cross cut into the top
1 rosemary sprig leaves picked and finely chopped
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 180C/160C/gas 4. Bake the camembert following pack instructions, then remove from the oven and leave to cool for 5 mins.

Meanwhile, put the nuts, paprika, thyme, rosemary and honey in a small saucepan. Season lightly. Bring to a simmer, stirring for a few minutes until aromatic and sticky. Pour this over the camembert and serve immediately with bread.
